scope: Local allocation diagnostic only. Separate arm uses two same-parameter raw CCtx instances and fresh output Vecs; shared arm uses one CCtx and two reusable output Vecs. Both provide full compress_bound capacity. Releasing previous outputs versus clearing reusable outputs is included in each encode timer. Canonical SCVAL construction, input loading, hashes, comparison to independent original Whole and SchemaZstd frames, and decoding are outside compression timers. The intermediate is prepared equally for both arms; no intermediate-allocation saving is claimed. Context constructors separately timed. Pair interval contains nested stages; never add those intervals. Arm CCtx workspace and output capacities are not process RSS. All first-use and repeated cases retained; no network or energy claim.
